subject: Novatech renewal: hygiene check & risk mitigation
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Novatech renewal: hygiene check & ask list

Team —

Quick hygiene on Novatech (term ends 2026-12-31). I need a short readout by EOD Tuesday so finance can bake the forecast: 

- Current stage in SFDC and committed ARR we should show? (please confirm exact committed ARR and booking cadence)
- Primary churn signals (usage trends, exec sponsor changes, support escalations) — one-liners fine
- Outstanding procurement/legal items blocking signature (PO, SOC evidence, SOW redlines)
- Recommended mitigation (offer, credits, exec outreach) and owner

I attached the internal Q3 usage export as a starting point (shared internally). If we surface a high-risk account we should mark it in the weekly forecast sweep and propose a clear next step.

Thanks — Camila
Camila Reyes
Sr. AM, Renewal & Expansion
Redwood Inference

Attachments: novatech_q3_usage_summary.csv (internal export stub)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T11:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Novatech renewal: hygiene check & ask list

Camila —

Quick notes from GTM: 
- SFDC stage: "Commit - Legal" (closing probability currently set to 70%).
- Committed ARR (per contract owner): $420,000 annual; renewal term same as current (12 months).
- Churn signals: 1) sustained 28% drop in token consumption the last 6 weeks (see attached summary), 2) exec sponsor (CTO) on extended leave, 3) two minor support escalations in Sept that were resolved but bumped NPS down.
- Procurement has asked for SOC2 Type II evidence and a revised SOW that reflects new usage buckets.

Mitigation suggestion: schedule an executive touchpoint w/ Marta (Novatech) next week, and offer a one-time $30k credit tied to usage restoration (conditional on 12-month commit). If finance signs off, that reduces churn risk materially.

Owner: Lauren to run exec scheduling; Camila to own credit ask; Michael to confirm finance impact.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Account Lead, Enterprise Sales

Attachments: novatech_q3_usage_summary.csv (summary slice)

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-06T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Novatech renewal: hygiene check & ask list

Camila / Lauren —

Finance input: if we model the account as a risk (no commit) it pulls ~ $420k ARR out of the Q4 forecast. We can support a one-time credit of up to $30k as a commercial concession, but it needs to be structured as a usage credit applied only if they hit a minimum monthly usage threshold for the first 3 months of the renewal. That preserves upside and limits write-offs.

Procurement note: they have requested a formal PO timeline; Procurement told us they may need 45–60 days due to internal approvals. If Novatech cannot get PO in time, legal is open to a short-term amendment to bridge until PO is issued.

I'll flag this in FIN-987 and add a note to the forecast model. If we move forward with the credit, provide final wording for the credit condition and I'll route the revenue deferral accordingly.

—Michael
Michael Grant
Director, Revenue Operations (Finance Liaison)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@novatech.com>, Novatech Procurement <procurement@novatech.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T14:30:00-08:00
Subject: Novatech renewal — mutual action plan + checklist (please confirm)

Marta —

Thanks for the productive conversation earlier. To keep the renewal healthy on both sides, I've attached a short mutual action plan (v2) and a one-page checklist. Can you confirm the following by EOD Wednesday so we can finalize internal approvals?

- Procurement timeline for PO (estimated date)
- Any additional SOC/compliance evidence required beyond SOC2 Type II
- Key stakeholders who should be on the signature page / SOW (name & role)

Per our internal review we see 3 levers to reduce friction:
1) SOC2 evidence packet (we can provide within 48 hours) — owner: Naomi
2) Short bridge amendment if PO delay exceeds 30 days — owner: Legal (we'll circulate)
3) Conditional $30k usage credit as described by Finance — owner: Camila / Michael to finalize language

Appreciate confirmation on the procurement timeline so we can update the quarterly forecast.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Sr. AM, Renewal & Expansion
Redwood Inference

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v2.pdf (stub)

From: Marta Ruiz <marta@novatech.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Novatech Procurement <procurement@novatech.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T15:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Novatech renewal — mutual action plan + checklist (please confirm)

Camila / team —

Thanks for the clear summary and the MAP. A few items from our side: 

- Procurement timeline: current internal approval window is mid-December; we are targeting PO issuance by 2026-12-14 but I cannot promise earlier.
- Compliance: we need the SOC2 packet and the customer-facing AUP document. Can Naomi send both?
- SOW: attached are our redlines to the SOW (see Novatech_SOW_redlines.pdf). We propose a small language change around data retention.
- Financial: headcount freeze has tightened budgets for Q1; we will likely ask for a discount or alternative commercial structure. Can Redwood share what a 12-month committed discount would look like?

We are open to the conditional credit proposal but would prefer the concession to be reflected as a short-term billing credit rather than a usage clawback. Happy to discuss on a quick call — I can make time Thursday morning.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
VP Product, Novatech

Attachments: Novatech_SOW_redlines.pdf (customer redlines)
notes: Forecast action: flag deal NW-2026-0123 as 'at-risk' in the weekly forecast sweep until PO or signed SOW is received.
Next meeting: schedule exec touchpoint with Marta; Lauren to propose two time slots; Camila to prepare the usage recovery plan before the call.
Finance: Michael to confirm final wording for the conditional credit and update revenue deferral entries in FIN-987.
